Description: Calendar of inspections and preventive maintenance (PM) based on time or metrics.
Format Justification: It is a set of rules in the DB.

Description: Design files that serve as a visual base for the Digital Twin.
Format Justification: It is a file you upload/download.

Description: Real-time readings (vibration, temperature, pressure) via MQTT/IoT.
Format Justification: Flows continuously.

Description: Usage records, operating hours, and production cycles.
Format Justification: Saved in the DB history.

Description: Digital checklists, photos, and videos of anomalies captured in the field.
Format Justification: Responses are saved in the DB.

Description: Formal request for a specific inventory component (MRO).
Format Justification: Creates a "Request" row in the DB.

Description: Unstructured documents with third-party work reports.
Format Justification: It is a file upload.

Description: Formal document detailing the task, resources, person responsible, and instructions.
Format Justification: Mainly data in the DB (can be exported as PDF, but IS a record).

Description: Legal authorization for high-risk work (Heights, Hot, Confined).
Format Justification: Same as above. It is a record in the DB with a state.

Description: Final record with hours, parts used, and description of the solution.
Format Justification: Similar to Inspection Data (https://app.notion.com/p/Inspection-Data-2ce87c56a82880338b6ac520b1de513d?pvs=21)

Description: Chronological record of all interventions performed on an asset.
Format Justification: It is a consolidated record in the DB.

Description: Key information automatically extracted from the contractor report (AI).
Format Justification: It is the JSON payload extracted by the AI.

Description: Automatic notices: Operational (low stock) or Predictive (imminent failure).
Format Justification: It is a trigger.

Description: Real-time visualization of state and degradation (Health Index).
Format Justification: It is a calculated view.

Description: Key metrics for strategic management (MTBF, MTTR, OEE).
Format Justification: It is a calculated view.

Description: Abstract definition of the equipment (Model, Manufacturer, Manuals, Taxonomy). No serial, defines "what it is".
Format Justification: Works as the "Class" or template. Defined once and related to multiple assets to avoid duplicating manuals or photos.

Description: The unique physical instance with a Serial Number (SN). Contains its current state, location, and link to history.
Format Justification: Requires a unique identity (ID) in the DB to trace the life cycle and failures of that specific object.

Description: Available quantity of a spare part or consumable (Oil, Screws) in a specific warehouse.
Format Justification: Manages transactional data (Quantities, Average Cost) and alert thresholds, not individual histories.

Description: The logical place or position in the plant where an asset operates (e.g., "Loading Bay 1").
Format Justification: Allows replacing the physical asset (e.g., replacing a damaged pump) without losing the failure history of that position in the plant.

Description: Support documentation provided by the product manufacturer.
Format Justification: They are static files (PDF, CAD) loaded once and viewed on demand.

Description: The trained algorithm and its current configuration. Subject to retraining and versioning.
Detailed and chronological record of each inventory transaction (receipts, issues, adjustments).
Formal requirement generated towards the external purchasing system due to shortages or reorder.
